rows.en: ONE-SEVEN, SABURO… ONE-SEVEN, SABURO…
Big Angel has produced an answer! "One-Seven, Saburo, One-Seven, Saburo"
One-Seven, Saburo…? What on earth does that mean?
One-Seven, tell me! How can we destroy Brain?
BY BIG ANGEL'S ANSWER, YOU WILL DIE TOO… ONE-SEVEN CANNOT DO IT.

If it means taking out Brain and slowing down the space fortress's invasion even a little, I don't care if I die!

One-Seven, please! Tell me!
THE ONLY WAY TO DEFEAT BRAIN IS TO RAM HIM!

You can't get close to Brain unless I'm piloting! Right, One-Seven…?

Brain killed my parents and my sister! I can't forgive Brain!
ONE-SEVEN UNDERSTANDS! RAPID ASCENT…
Thank you, One-Seven! Let's go!!

…!?

What are they going to do?

One-Seven… obey Brain! Help Brain achieve his grand purpose.

The Earth will be destroyed by machine civilization… All civilization must be wiped from the face of the Earth! And for that, the Space Fortress Naager must land on the surface.
This is bad! One-Seven means to crash right into Brain!

What…!?

Saburo, it's dangerous! Get out, quick!! Bail out! Saburooo!!

Brain is right…

Brain is the great good…

Brain is the ruler of the Earth… Brain is… Brain is…
SABURO, NOW WE DIVE…
All right, let's go! One-Seven!!
GOODBYE, SABURO…

What!? One-Seven? What do you mean?

Uwaaaagh…
One-Seven's going to hit him!

Ow ow ow…!?

One-Seveeen!!
So this is the end of Brain…
And of One-Seven too…
Daitetsujin One-Seven… I'll never forget your name!
That's right! The name One-Seven will be carved deep in everyone's heart…
One-Seven is an immortal number, isn't it…
Ah…
Father…

It's the Space Fortress Naager…

It's finally landing… The time has come for that colossus to put down roots on the Earth.
Damn it… We'll never make it in time! Can't we even put a scratch on them!?
[HERO2]! The Space Fortress Naager has picked up speed. It's descending to the surface!!

…!?

We couldn't do anything… We couldn't do a single thing!
[HERO2]! The Space Fortress Naager just sped up. Looks like it's coming straight down to the surface.
Under a surprise attack by Naager fighters, fully half of the TDF Far East Base's forces were wiped out in an instant… The Naager's invasion of Earth had finally begun.
Director! The defense line in orbit has been breached!!
Is this the end!?
Predict the Naager's landing point and issue an evacuation advisory to residents of that area!

Yes, sir!

…!?

Th-this is…!?
What is it, what's wrong? Where is the Naager going to come down!?
At a point 20 kilometers west of the Far East Base.
What!?

…!?

All personnel, evacuate to the lowest level immediately!!

Roger!

Attention, all Far East Base personnel… Evacuate to the lowest level immediately! This is not a drill!!

I repeat, this is not a drill!!
Director! We should too…

Have we…

Have we humans lost…!?
Ah, shooting stars? And so many of them…?

[HERO4]… those aren't shooting stars!

They're pieces of the Naager's hull that burned up when it entered the atmosphere, falling to the ground…

Hey… doesn't it look like the Earth is crying?

Ah, shooting stars! And so many of them…?

Umm… a wish, a wish…!

Silly [HERO4]… those aren't shooting stars!

They're pieces of the Naager's hull that burned up when it entered the atmosphere, falling to the ground…

Are we really going to lose like this? Us…
That day, in the clear night sky, mankind saw a giant meteor falling, one that would bring them an unprecedented calamity…
The Naager skimmed over the TDF Far East Base and slowly, silently touched down in the Mt. Fuji Sea of Trees, right under the base's nose.
Its bow pointed toward the heavens, its form like an impregnable citadel rose up in the moonlight. At the sight of it, people felt an instinctive terror…
Waaah…
One-Seveeen…!!
Chief Kitakuraaa!!
Captain Sawaaa!!
Defeat Brain and all Brain robots and Kelbaans!
Defeat all Brain robots and Kelbaans!
Defeat Brain!
Defeat Brain and all Kelbaans!
Defeat all Kelbaans and Gigants!
Chief Kitakura or Captain Sawa is defeated
One-Seven or Chief Kitakura is defeated
Tokyo… no, Japan… no, the entire Earth was going on with its peaceful, uneventful days.
But a very few people sensed something ominous in this calm.
That ominous something was an indescribable unease: that the final battle with their greatest enemy, Emperor Guillotine, who plotted to conquer the Earth, would come before long.
Those who felt that unease, namely the agents of Unicorn who protect the world's peace and safety, were desperately tracking the movements of Emperor Guillotine and the BF to prepare for that day…
This is the Japan Branch, Japan Branch… This wavelength is different from Unicorn's! Could it be…

The BF may be on the move again.

We need to know anything we can about the BF's movements right now…

All right… U7, U3!
Use the radio-detection vehicle and pinpoint the transmission source at once!
Roger!
Geez, it's suffocating! Everybody, starting with Branch Chief Higashi, is on edge…
Well, it can't be helped! Those BF guys must be plotting something.

Well, maybe so, but…

just not having to hear Branch Chief Higashi yelling inside the branch makes field work a relief.
You fool!!

Oops!?

Daisaku… you left the radio switch on, didn't you? Branch Chief Higashi heard us.
This is no time for idle chatter!
The strange signal's transmission point is near you! Don't dawdle!
Yes, sir! We'll do our best!

…!?

What's that sound?

uncertain: U14829/U14836: キュウジョウショウ / キュウコウカ read as 急上昇 (rapid ascent) / 急降下 (dive).
U14822: ［］ brackets around Big Angel's answer changed to double quotes.
U14844: 大鉄人ワンセブン rendered 'Daitetsujin One-Seven' (series title).
U14860: 皀へ20キロ read as 西へ (west), since the Naager lands in the Mt. Fuji Sea of Trees (U14871); could be 北 (north).
U14875/U14876: Sawa and Kitakura call to each other; these may be the cut-in lines for U14804-U14805.
U14884-U14887: narration beginning the Giant Robo stage; tense kept in narrative past.
